title: The Ministry has filed you under Harry Potter villain
dek: Twelve questions about loyalty, ambition and how you'd handle a secret. The file is already open; you're just confirming the details.

questions.prompt: The Ministry offers you a deal. You:

options.label: Take it, then rewrite the terms
Refuse, loudly, in front of everyone
Sign it, then start a file on whoever offered
Say nothing and use the time to plan
Everyone underestimates how much I enjoy this
A name that opens doors
Patience measured in decades
Being the person nobody watches
Feared, and correctly so
Indispensable, and quietly so
A long table with too many empty chairs
options.alt: A formal boardroom with a long table and empty chairs

options.label: A tall window over a city you intend to own
options.alt: A tall window looking out over a city

options.label: A laboratory nobody has signed for
options.alt: A cluttered laboratory bench with equipment

options.label: Somewhere grand, and visibly falling apart
options.alt: A dark building under a heavy storm sky

questions.helper: Across: one person, or the idea. Up: in the open, or from the shadows.

questions.prompt: Rank what you'd actually risk everything for.
questions.helper: First place is the one you'd never trade.
Two gaps. Everything you say will be quoted.
questions.template: They say I'm {a}, which is exactly {b}.

options.label: the reasonable one
the loyal one
the clever one
the one who was never really here
what I want them to think
why it works
why nobody suspects me
why I'm still standing

questions.prompt: I'd rather be useful to the winning side than right.
The cause matters more than the person leading it.
Rules are only real if somebody enforces them.

options.label: Undone by the one person I trusted
Still here, still explaining myself
Caught in the lie I built
Remembered as the one who almost won

questions.prompt: What people get wrong about you:

options.label: That I'm cruel. I'm efficient.
That I'm weak. I'm patient.
That I'm a follower. I chose this.
That I lost. I'm not finished.

results.name: Lord Voldemort
results.blurb: You do not improvise and you do not explain. Everything is a step, everyone is a piece, and the fact that people find this unsettling is their problem. You are genuinely brilliant at the long game, which is why it takes a whole coalition to stop you.
strengths: Sees the board, not the move
results.watchOut: You keep your pieces so far apart that nobody will warn you when one breaks.

results.name: Bellatrix Lestrange
results.blurb: You are not here for the ideology. You are here for one person, and you would burn a great deal for them. Your certainty is the most frightening thing about you, and the most moving, depending on which side of it someone stands.
results.watchOut: A loyalty that never asks questions eventually gets used. Ask one.

results.name: Dolores Umbridge
results.blurb: You know that power is mostly paperwork, and that a smile makes a threat land harder. You are excellent at institutions: their procedures, their loopholes, their quiet punishments. People underestimate you until they are in a meeting with you.
strengths: Remembers every rule and every exception
results.watchOut: Being technically correct is not the same as being right. Check which one you need.

results.name: Lucius Malfoy
results.tagline: Everything is a transaction, including loyalty
results.blurb: You are smooth, connected and always aware of which way the room is leaning. You never make a threat you can't fund, and you never spend a favour without a return. It works, right up until the moment someone less careful gets you caught.
strengths: Reads which way power is moving
results.watchOut: You hedge so well that nobody is certain you're on their side. Pick one, occasionally.

results.name: Draco Malfoy
results.tagline: Given the role before the choice
results.blurb: You were handed a part to play before you could read the script, and you've been performing it ever since. Underneath the sneer there is someone doing arithmetic about what happens if they fail, and finding the answer unpleasant. You are braver than you let on and much less sure.
strengths: Better under pressure than he admits
results.watchOut: You keep performing the part and never say what you actually want. Say it.

results.name: Peter Pettigrew
results.blurb: You are the person in the room nobody counts, which is precisely the advantage you've built everything on. You read danger early, you make yourself small, and you always know where the exit is. It is not glamorous, but you are still here.
results.watchOut: You've survived so long by siding with whoever's winning that you've forgotten your own position.

results.name: Barty Crouch Jr.
results.blurb: You are the most committed person in the room and the only one who read the whole brief. You will play a role for a year without breaking, and you'll enjoy the details nobody else notices. Your weakness is that you cannot resist explaining it afterwards.
strengths: Total commitment to a long cover
Thinks several moves past the obvious
results.watchOut: You save the reveal for the perfect moment. The perfect moment was earlier.

results.name: Gellert Grindelwald
results.tagline: A better world, honestly, for some
results.blurb: You are not interested in petty cruelty. You have a vision, and you are unnervingly good at making it sound reasonable. People follow you because you describe the world they already wanted, and you are careful never to say the cost out loud.
results.watchOut: You've built a cause where the exceptions are always someone else. Name one.
